item.title: Omutengenekwafaneko owa shuna pedu nobiliona N$1
item.description: Auleria Wakudumo Omutengenekwafaneko womudo 2026/2027 owa shuna pedu nobiliona N$1,3 okuyelekanifa nomutengenekwafaneko womudo 2025/2026. Minista wemona Ericah Shafudah okwa holola omutengenekwafaneko woshimaliwa shomudo 2026/2027 shi fike peebiliona N$105.
